dialogues.text_zh: 哈哈，說得好像妳一點都不期待似地。看看這一縮一張的小菊穴，在本魔王看來……妳也很期待接下來會發生什麼，對吧？

dialogues.speaker: Ashiya Doma
dialogues.text: Mm... hmph! I can't agree with that statement, but... I won't completely deny it, either♥
dialogues.text_zh: 唔……哼！對於你的說法我無法贊同，不過……也不完全否認就是了♥

role_voices.text_zh: 你好呀，我是陰陽師蘆屋道滿。哼哼……聽到我的名字就嚇得渾身發抖了對吧？
role_voices.text_en: Greetings. I am the onmyoki, Ashiya Doma. Heh heh... Just hearing my name is enough to make you tremble, doesn't it

role_voices.text_zh: 哈哈！賺到錢當然就是要拿來享樂呀～存那麼多做什麼？
role_voices.text_en: Haha! Money is meant to be spent on having fun, of course! What's the point of saving so much?

role_voices.text_zh: 哼，我的咒術可和那些平凡的陰陽術不同……給我看清楚了！喝啊——！
role_voices.text_en: Hmph, my Jujutsu is nothing like ordinary Onmyodo... Watch closely! Haaah—!

role_voices.text_zh: 晴明那個臭女人……！我一定要親手打敗她，讓她跪在地上向我求饒！
role_voices.text_en: That bitch Seimei...! I'll defeat her with my own two hands and make her kneel and beg me for mercy!

role_voices.text_zh: 源博雅，可愛善良的孩子。只可惜……她的身份無法允許她永遠這般純真下去。
role_voices.text_en: Minamoto no Hiromasa, such a sweet and kind child. It's just a shame... her status won't allow her to remain so pure forever.

role_voices.text_zh: 小次郎會和武藏吃飯、逛街、談心……這樣算情侶還是宿敵？嘔！總之，我和晴明絕不會變成那樣。
role_voices.text_en: Kojiro and Musashi eat together, go shopping, and talk heart to heart... Are they supposed to be lovers or arch-rivals? Ugh! Whatever. There's no way Seimei and I are ever going to end up like that.

role_voices.text_zh: 來，張開嘴巴，啊～。如何，我親手做的唐揚雞好吃嗎？你和晴明應該沒有做過這種事吧？
role_voices.text_en: Here, open your mouth, say 'aah'~. How is it? Is my homemade karaage delicious? I bet you and Seimei have never done anything like this, have you?

role_voices.text_zh: 除了觸手，我還用過什麼妖怪自慰？唔……哼！幹嘛要告訴你？
role_voices.text_en: What other yokai have I used to masturbate besides tentacles? Mmm... Hmph! And why should I tell you?

role_voices.text_zh: 啊嗯嗯——！唔嗯、唔嗯嗯！不管用什麼妖怪自慰，都沒有你的肉棒舒服呀♥
role_voices.text_en: Nnghh—! Mmph, mmm! No matter what yokai I use to masturbate, nothing feels as good as your cock ♥.

role_voices.text_zh: 哼！就憑你們也想阻止我！
role_voices.text_en: Hmph! You think the likes of you can stop me?!
Let it all turn to ash!

role_voices.text_zh: 哼……別以為…這樣就結束了……
role_voices.text_en: Hmph... Don't think... it's over just yet...

role_voices.text_zh: 畏懼我吧！這就是咒術的力量！
role_voices.text_en: Fear me! This is the power of Jujutsu!
